payload.body_you:
Shared money stops being a side conversation. The loan. The tax bill. The account one person controls. The help that comes with conditions nobody named at the beginning. Saturn moving through your 8th house makes it harder to pretend that money, trust, and power are separate subjects.

Know what you owe, what you own, and how much of your future depends on someone continuing to cooperate. Keep copies of the paperwork. Build more independence where you can. That does not mean refusing support. It means understanding the agreement before your life depends on it.
